title: WebFetchUrlSources
description:
Which sources contribute to the set of URLs web fetch may fetch.

Each key is a tagged variant: ``user_input`` is ``all`` or ``none``; the
two tool filters are ``all``, ``none``, ``only`` (only the named tools'
results) or ``except`` (every result but the named tools'). A named tool
must be declared in this request's ``tools[]``.

client_tool_results.description: Which client tools' results contribute fetchable URLs: "all", "none", or an only or except list of client tool names from tools[].
client_tool_results.title: Client Tool Results

server_tool_results.description: Which server tools' results contribute fetchable URLs: "all", "none", or an only or except list of server tool names from tools[]; only web_search and web_fetch results ever contribute.
server_tool_results.title: Server Tool Results

user_input.description: Whether URLs in user messages are fetchable: "all" or "none".
user_input.title: User Input
